how.title: Three steps. Zero drama.
how.sub: From the moment your battery turns red to the moment it's green again.

steps.title: Scan and pay
steps.text: Scan the QR code on the station, a secure payment page opens in your browser, pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or a credit card, and your power bank is released. No app, no sign-up.

steps.title: Charge anywhere
steps.text: The power bank goes where you go. Three built-in cables, so it fits any phone, iPhone or Android.

steps.title: Return at any station
steps.text: Done? Drop it at any FULLIN station, not necessarily the one you took it from.

how.note: The app is optional, but it helps you find a nearby station and manage your rentals.

price.title: A price you can explain in one breath
price.sub: First hour free when you download the app, and there's always a cap after that. No surprises.

steps.label: First hour
steps.text: Download the app and your first charge is on us.

steps.label: After the first hour
steps.text: You only pay for the time you actually use.

steps.label: Daily cap
steps.text: Even if you forget it in your bag until tonight, you'll never pay more than ₪50 a day.

steps.label: Day two
steps.text: A new day, a new cap. ₪100 in total for two days.

steps.label: If it's not returned
steps.text: The maximum total charge is ₪200, not a shekel more.

price.totalTitle: So what's the most you can pay?
price.totalText: ₪200 in total, even in the worst case, when the power bank never comes back.
price.footnote: The free hour is a benefit for app users. No subscription. No hidden fees. Pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or a credit card.
price.noApp: Without the app: ₪12 per hour from the first minute

items.q: How do I rent a power bank?
items.a: Scan the QR code on the station with your phone's camera or through the FULLIN app, pay, and your power bank is released.

items.q: Do I need to download the app?
items.a: Not required. You can also rent by scanning the QR on the station, and then you pay ₪12 per hour from the first minute. In the app the first hour is free, and it also finds nearby stations and keeps track of your rental.

items.q: Where do I return the power bank?
items.a: At any FULLIN station. It doesn't have to be the one you took it from.

With the app: first hour free. Without the app: ₪12 per hour from the first minute. Either way, it's ₪12 per hour after that, capped at ₪50 per day. Day two is another ₪50 at most, so ₪100 for two days. No subscription and no hidden fees.

items.q: Who gets the free first hour?
items.a: The free first hour is a benefit for people who download the app. If you rent without the app, by scanning the QR on the station, you pay ₪12 per hour from the first minute.

items.q: What happens if I don't return the power bank?
items.a: A further ₪100 is charged, and the maximum total is ₪200.

items.q: Which payment methods can I use?
items.a: Apple Pay, Google Pay and credit card.
